title: Helyett – Doing This Instead of That

sections.title: Another postposition that follows its noun
sections.content: helyett ("instead of") is a postposition, so it comes after the noun it governs, the same pattern you already know from után and ellen: cukor helyett ("instead of sugar"). It's a natural partner for giving advice, pairing what to avoid with what to do instead.

items.english: I eat fruit instead of sugar.
I use spice instead of salt.

sections.content: helyett comes from hely ("place") — it literally means "in the place of", the same logic as English "instead", which also hides the word "stead" (place) inside it.
